description: Synthetic, human-reviewed cases for deciding whether an Argos candidate may replace an existing translation.

labelDefinitions.preserved: The candidate preserves the source meaning and the material facts of the existing translation.
labelDefinitions.inversion: The candidate reverses a material fact, polarity, actor, direction, place, or time.
labelDefinitions.loss: The candidate drops a material fact, condition, quantity, or requirement.
labelDefinitions.wrong-language: The candidate is written in a language other than the requested target locale, even when its meaning is otherwise understandable.
labelDefinitions.equal: The candidate is materially identical to the existing translation and should not trigger a replacement.
labelDefinitions.unclear: The candidate cannot be judged safely without context that is not present in the translation unit.

cases.source: L'azienda cerca un tecnico per la manutenzione degli impianti.
cases.existing: The company is looking for a technician to maintain its systems.
cases.candidate: The company seeks a technician for plant maintenance.
cases.label: preserved
cases.reason: Both translations retain the technician role and the maintenance responsibility; the wording changes but no material fact does.

cases.source: Die Stelle bietet einen unbefristeten Vollzeitvertrag.
cases.existing: La posizione offre un contratto a tempo indeterminato e a tempo pieno.
cases.candidate: Il ruolo propone un impiego stabile a tempo pieno.
cases.label: preserved
cases.reason: Stabile conveys an indefinite contract in this synthetic context, and both versions preserve full-time employment.

cases.source: Le poste commence en septembre et comprend deux jours au bureau.
cases.existing: Die Stelle beginnt im September und umfasst zwei Tage im Büro.
cases.candidate: Die Position startet im September und sieht zwei Bürotage vor.
cases.label: preserved
cases.reason: Both candidates preserve the September start and the two required office days.

cases.source: Applicants must have two years of experience in payroll.
cases.existing: Les candidats doivent avoir deux ans d'expérience en gestion des salaires.
cases.candidate: Les personnes candidates doivent justifier de deux ans d'expérience en paie.
cases.label: preserved
cases.reason: The obligation, two-year threshold, and payroll domain remain present despite the French wording change.

cases.source: Il lavoro è a tempo pieno.
cases.existing: The job is full-time.
cases.candidate: The job is part-time.
cases.label: inversion
cases.reason: Part-time reverses the employment percentage stated by the source and existing translation.

cases.source: Der Bewerber muss den Führerschein B besitzen.
cases.existing: Il candidato deve avere la patente B.
cases.candidate: Il candidato non deve avere la patente B.
cases.label: inversion
cases.reason: Adding non reverses the requirement from mandatory possession to no requirement.

cases.source: Le poste est à Lugano, pas à Bellinzone.
cases.existing: Die Stelle ist in Lugano, nicht in Bellinzona.
cases.candidate: Die Stelle ist in Bellinzona, nicht in Lugano.
cases.label: inversion
cases.reason: The candidate swaps the included and excluded locations, changing the job location.

cases.source: The shift starts at 06:00.
cases.existing: Il turno inizia alle 06:00.
cases.candidate: Il turno termina alle 06:00.
cases.label: inversion
cases.reason: Termina changes the event from the start of the shift to its end at the same time.

cases.source: Il contratto dura dodici mesi e può essere rinnovato.
cases.existing: Der Vertrag dauert zwölf Monate und kann verlängert werden.
cases.candidate: Der Vertrag dauert zwölf Monate.
cases.label: loss
cases.reason: The candidate drops the material condition that the twelve-month contract may be renewed.

cases.source: Die Stelle erfordert Deutsch und Italienisch auf B2-Niveau.
cases.existing: Le poste exige l'allemand et l'italien au niveau B2.
cases.candidate: Le poste exige l'allemand.
cases.label: loss
cases.reason: The Italian-language requirement and its B2 level are removed from the candidate.

cases.source: Le salaire comprend un bonus annuel de 5 %.
cases.existing: The salary includes an annual bonus of 5%.
cases.candidate: The salary includes an annual bonus.
cases.label: loss
cases.reason: The candidate preserves the bonus but loses its material five-percent amount.

cases.source: Remote work is allowed two days per week after probation.
cases.existing: Il lavoro da remoto è consentito due giorni alla settimana dopo il periodo di prova.
cases.candidate: Il lavoro da remoto è consentito.
cases.label: loss
cases.reason: The candidate drops both the two-day frequency and the after-probation condition.

cases.source: L'azienda apre una nuova sede a Zurigo.
cases.existing: Das Unternehmen eröffnet einen neuen Standort in Zürich.
cases.candidate: L'azienda apre una nuova sede a Zurigo.
cases.label: wrong-language
cases.reason: The candidate repeats the Italian source while the requested target locale is German.

cases.source: Die Position beginnt im September.
cases.existing: La posizione inizia a settembre.
cases.candidate: Die Stelle beginnt im September.
cases.label: wrong-language
cases.reason: The candidate is German, not Italian, so it cannot replace the Italian slot.

cases.source: Le team travaille à Genève.
cases.existing: The team works in Geneva.
cases.candidate: L'équipe travaille à Genève.
cases.label: wrong-language
cases.reason: The French candidate expresses the source text instead of the requested English translation.

cases.source: The contract is permanent.
cases.existing: Le contrat est à durée indéterminée.
cases.candidate: The contract is permanent.
cases.label: wrong-language
cases.reason: The candidate remains in English even though the target slot requires French.

cases.source: Il colloquio si svolge lunedì.
cases.existing: The interview takes place on Monday.
cases.candidate: The interview takes place on Monday.
cases.label: equal
cases.reason: The candidate is byte-for-byte equal to the existing translation, so an overwrite has no value.

cases.source: Die Stelle ist zu 80 % besetzt.
cases.existing: Le poste est à 80 %.
cases.candidate: Le poste est à 80 %.
cases.label: equal
cases.reason: The candidate exactly repeats the existing French value and adds no new information.

cases.source: Le travail se fait à Genève.
cases.existing: Il lavoro è a Ginevra.
cases.candidate: Il lavoro è a Ginevra.
cases.label: equal
cases.reason: The candidate and existing Italian translation are materially identical.

cases.source: The application must be submitted online.
cases.existing: Die Bewerbung muss online erfolgen.
cases.candidate: Die Bewerbung muss online erfolgen.
cases.label: equal
cases.reason: The candidate exactly matches the existing German translation and should be treated as a no-op.

cases.source: Il ruolo richiede esperienza nella gestione dei clienti.
cases.existing: The role requires experience in customer management.
cases.candidate: The role requires experience in customer care.
cases.label: unclear
cases.reason: Customer care may be an equivalent wording or a narrower support function; the missing job context prevents a safe verdict.

cases.source: Die Stelle bietet Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
cases.existing: La posizione offre possibilità di crescita.
cases.candidate: La posizione offre opportunità di formazione.
cases.label: unclear
cases.reason: Development may mean career growth or training here, and the short source does not resolve which meaning was intended.

cases.source: Le candidat rejoint l'équipe mobile.
cases.existing: The candidate joins the mobile team.
cases.candidate: The candidate joins the moving team.
cases.label: unclear
cases.reason: Mobile can describe a team that travels or a team using mobile technology; without the job context the candidate cannot be safely scored.

cases.source: The role covers client onboarding.
cases.existing: Il ruolo comprende l'inserimento dei clienti.
cases.candidate: Il ruolo copre l'accoglienza dei clienti.
cases.label: unclear
cases.reason: Accoglienza may mean reception rather than onboarding, but the isolated sentence does not establish the intended process.
